data.name: WhatsNewBody
data.value:
Version 1.0.5: • Knowledge base: «+ Media» attaches audio and video (mp3, wav, m4a, mp4, mov and more), or drag them in. «Parse» transcribes the speech with the recognition settings, locally or through the API, and stores the text with time marks and a link to the file; a long transcription can be stopped. • The «+ Files» button is now «+ Documents». • The home screen always says «Hidden from screen share»: the dot is lit while the windows are hidden and goes out while others can see them. • «Questions» use the topic graph: the people and terms of a question lead to the linked tasks, decisions and documents, and older meetings where they came up join the answer with their lines. Build the graph on the «Graph» tab.
Version 1.0.4: • Settings: the provider comes first, then the API key and the models; «Speech recognition» has its own provider choice too (Polza.ai, OpenAI, Groq or your own address). • Models are picked from the provider's own list (Polza.ai also shows prices in ₽); typing narrows the list, and a model typed by hand is kept.
Version 1.0.3: • Knowledge base: drag files, groups of files, folders or text into it, or paste them with Ctrl+V; each file and folder becomes its own entry, text becomes a note. • The topic «Summary» is its own tab between «Sessions» and «Knowledge base». • «Questions» is a list like the sessions: newest on top, the answer opens on a click, delete one or several. • Starting CuePilot again shows the window that is already open, so hotkeys no longer clash; if another program holds a combination, one message says so. • Hover hints work in the overlay and the collapsed mode; a second click on the CuePilot icon folds the window. • Clear explanations of «Deep mode» and the glossary; auto-snapshot settings are greyed out when screenshots for AI are off.
Version 1.0.2: • A topic now has tabs: Sessions, Knowledge base, Questions and Graph. • Knowledge base: attach files (PDF, Word, Excel, pictures, txt, md), whole folders and your own text. Each item is parsed to Markdown with its own button and stored by CuePilot; the parsed text is shown on the right. • Questions: a dialog about the topic with history, answers from sessions and materials, with sources and discrepancies. • An Obsidian-style graph of entities and relations: drag, zoom, search, node card. • A more visible Back button. • Knowledge base sources can be removed one by one (× or Delete) or several at once («Select»): the graph is cleaned of their data at once, the summary is updated. • The preview of a parsed file is formatted Markdown with headings, lists and tables; big files open at once. • Parsing and other long actions run in the background, the window does not freeze. • The session cost moved from the cards and the header to a folding block on the «Usage» tab.
Version 1.0.1: • Topics: drag sessions into a topic; it builds a shared knowledge base from all its sessions (Update button). • «Ask about the topic»: answers from the current summaries and transcripts of all its sessions, with sources and a separate list of discrepancies between people and meetings. • Multi-select: delete or move several sessions, right-click a card for a menu. • The follow-up email now opens on the Email tab with a copy button. • Day and night theme, RU/EN language (EN records and answers in English). • Hints on every button after 2 seconds, compact header, new installer. • A new recording starts with an empty overlay dialog.
• New «Echo» design: logo and icon, Manrope font, listening animation. The overlay has an «Ask» button, and a question asked on the main screen appears in the overlay dialog. • Polza.ai: fast model for live hints, a stronger one for the summary and email; cost in ₽ per request and per session. • Optional speech recognition through the API; silence is skipped, recognition no longer falls behind on long calls. • No more slowdown on long sessions: every session is stored in its own file and saved in the background. • Overlay: «What to say» action, compact mode by clicking the title. • Interface, summary headings and the follow-up email are in Russian. • Installer with desktop and Start menu shortcuts.
